messages:
oliver: planning a tiered FF ramp for llm-route v3 tomorrow night (eu-west). Goal: conservative rollout with a surge-throttle multiplier and sticky-session expiry to avoid flip-flopping. Posting runbook + thresholds for ops.

deploybot: Scheduled window: 2026-04-15 22:00 UTC. Ramp plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% with 7m soak each. Surge-throttle: if traffic spike or retries detected, next step will be multiplied by 0.6 (floor) to attenuate surge. Sticky-session expiry: active sessions pinned to v2 for 40m. Runbook snippet: `/deploybot ff ramp --name=llm-route-v3 --steps=1,5,20,60,100 --soak=7m --surge-throttle=0.6 --pin=active_sessions --sticky-expiry=40m --monitor=llmroute.canary`

maya: prefer first step 0.5% if cohorts allow fractional split. Also request deploybot post cohort counts and error delta after each step.

oncall: I'll take watch for first 45m. Alert triggers: error-rate +2% abs for 4m OR p95 > 350ms for 5m => auto-stepdown one level and notify #eng-oncall. Emergency cut: REQ_ERRORS > 4x baseline for 2m -> ff set to 0 and pin rollback cohorts to v2.

infra: We'll pre-pin v2 for heavy_cohorts and vip_accounts for 1h to ensure deterministic rollback. Pin command: `/infra ff pin --name=llm-route-v3 --cohorts=heavy_cohorts,vip_accounts --version=v2 --duration=1h`. Auto-unpin only after 30m stable at 100% or manual approval.

oliver: release notes line: "llm-route v3 staged rollout with tiered ramp, surge-throttle attenuation, and session stickiness for rollback safety." Adding runbook to release doc.

maya: ops checklist to include: 1) confirm GPU headroom <70% between steps, 2) enable verbose routing traces for 30m post-100%, 3) deploybot EMERG key oncall reachable.

oncall: I'll post dashboard link and update with metric diffs at each step. Ready to cut if alarms fire.

oliver: rollback procedure: `/deploybot ff set llm-route-v3 0` then `/infra ff unpin --name=llm-route-v3 --cohorts=heavy_cohorts,vip_accounts` validate v2 healthy for 15m before clear. Keeping this thread pinned as canonical ops feed during the window. :white_check_mark:
